title: Rapid Security Triage (Fast Checking)
markdown:
**Rapid security triage** is the discipline of taking an **inbound signal**-scanner finding, researcher report, pen-test note, bug-bounty submission, or engineer's "is this bad?"-and **quickly** deciding **validity**, **severity**, **owner**, and **next action** without drowning in false positives. It powers **VM programs**, **incident** intake, **AppSec** consult queues, and **executive** escalations. Strong triage balances **speed**, **accuracy**, **reproducibility**, and **stakeholder** communication.

Uses the **[Content Mastery Framework](../Interview%20Preparation/Content%20Mastery%20Framework.md)**.

children.title: Interview prompts
60-second answer
children.markdown:
**Q: How do you triage security findings quickly without missing real issues?**

**A:** I use a **consistent** pipeline: **normalize** the report (asset, version, environment), **dedupe** against known issues, set a **reproducibility** bar (confirmed vs likely vs speculative), then score **impact** with **business** context-not **CVSS** alone. I use **EPSS** and **KEV** to prioritize **CVE** noise, and I **route** to the right owner with a **clear** ask and **SLA**. I document **why** something is closed or deferred so we don't re-litigate. Speed comes from **templates** and **criteria**, not from skipping **thinking**.
children.notes:

I use EPSS and KEV to prioritize CVE noise, and I route to the right owner with a clear ask and SLA. I document why something is closed or deferred so we don't re-litigate. Speed comes from templates and criteria, not from skipping thinking.

children.title: Process
Q: What is the difference between triage and root-cause analysis?
children.markdown: **A:** **Triage** decides **priority**, **validity at high confidence**, and **routing**. **RCA** explains **why** code allowed the bug and **how** to prevent **recurrence**. Triage can **stop** at "valid, P2, AppSec queue"; RCA is **post-fix** or **parallel** for **severe** incidents.
children.notes: A: Triage decides priority, validity at high confidence, and routing. RCA explains why code allowed the bug and how to prevent recurrence. Triage can stop at "valid, P2, AppSec queue"; RCA is post-fix or parallel for severe incidents.
children.blurb: A: Triage decides priority, validity at high confidence, and routing.
